contract.permission_isolation: Permission denial for one event does not affect another event
contract.denied_emit: An emitter without events permission is rejected before delivery
contract.delivery_isolation: A rejected emit produces no listener delivery
contract.cross_event_independence: A denied emit for event A does not block successful delivery of event B
contract.subsequent_delivery: A later authorized emit for event A remains successful after a denied emit
contract.ordering: Successful deliveries retain deterministic event-local order
contract.registry_stability: Permission rejection does not mutate listener registries
contract.source_integrity: Source payloads remain unchanged after rejected or successful emits
contract.permission_enforcement: Each emit checks the events permission independently
